title: Welcome back to the channel
text: Hey everyone, welcome back to the channel. Let's get into it.

title: Butler announces your popularity
text: Your phone is ringing. It has apparently decided you are popular.

title: Your fan club is calling
text: Attention, superstar! Your fan club is calling. Membership: one.

title: Tiny pocket concert
text: Incoming call! Your pocket is hosting a tiny concert.

title: Call from your future self
text: Ring ring! This is your future self. Pick up; we need to talk.

title: Someone wants a favor
text: Someone wants you. Probably for a favor.

title: Panicked number alert
text: Emergency! Someone has discovered your phone number!

title: The sacred rectangle
text: Behold! The sacred rectangle demands your attention!

title: Your celebrity era continues
text: Your phone rings again. Your celebrity era continues.

title: I can hear you ignoring me
text: Hello? Hello? I can hear you ignoring me.

title: The universe (or your aunt) calls
text: The universe is calling. It sounds suspiciously like your aunt.

title: Mission from planet Earth
text: Incoming call from planet Earth. Do you accept the mission?

title: The tiny people request an audience
text: The tiny people inside your phone request an audience.

title: Fame is exhausting, darling
text: Ring ring, darling. Fame is exhausting, isn’t it?

title: Town crier: a call!
text: A call! A call! Release the royal answering thumb!

title: Try looking surprised
text: Your phone is ringing. Try looking surprised.

title: It is not a pizza
text: Somebody called. We checked. It is not a pizza.

title: Your phone works weekends
text: This is your phone speaking. I work weekends, apparently.

title: Cue the dramatic music
text: The call has arrived. Cue the dramatic music!

title: The noisy thing again

title: Until morale improves
text: The ringing will continue until morale improves.

title: Hello, boss
text: Hello, boss! You have a text message.

text: Psst! A tiny letter just landed.

text: Message delivered. Mystery not included.

text: Ding! Someone typed at you.

title: Words from another human
text: Incoming words from another human.

title: Your phone has gossip
text: Your phone has gossip.

title: A message, your majesty
text: A message awaits, your majesty.

title: Important, or a meme?
text: New text. Could be important. Could be a meme.

title: Someone pressed send
text: Someone has pressed send.

title: The plot thickens

title: You have been texted

title: Your inbox just blinked
text: Your inbox just blinked.

title: Secret transmission
text: Secret transmission received.

title: Your bed filed a complaint
text: Good morning! Your bed has filed a complaint. You have overstayed your welcome.

title: Your pillow can't do your job
text: Rise and shine! Your pillow cannot do your job for you.

title: The snooze button doesn't believe
text: This is your alarm. I believe in you. Your snooze button does not.

title: Coffee won't admire itself
text: Wake up! The coffee is not going to admire itself.

title: Sleeping legend, wake up
text: Attention, sleeping legend! The world has started without you.

title: Blanket voted off the island
text: Good morning. Your blanket has been voted off the island.

title: The breakfast ship sails
text: Wake up, captain! The breakfast ship is leaving port!

text: Your dream has ended. Please exit through the nearest eyelid.

title: The sun already clocked in

title: Your socks need leadership
text: Morning alert! Your socks are waiting for leadership.

title: Noon is not a personality
text: This is a friendly reminder that noon is not a personality.

title: Even the toaster has plans
text: Wake up! Even the toaster has plans today.

title: Your kingdom needs coffee
text: Good morning, royalty. Your kingdom needs coffee.

title: Parting ways with the mattress
text: The mattress has enjoyed your company. It is time to part ways.

title: Your future self is waiting
text: Up you get! Your future self is tapping their watch.

title: Deploy feet to floor
text: Wake-up protocol activated. Deploy feet to floor.

title: The sun says MOVE
text: The sun says hello. Your alarm says MOVE.

title: Dreams can wait in the lobby
text: Rise and shine! Your dreams can wait in the lobby.

title: Snooze committee dissolved
text: Good morning! The snooze committee has been dissolved.

title: Today's episode starts now
text: Wake up, superstar! Today is your next episode.

title: Limited edition birthday
text: Happy birthday! You are not getting older. You are becoming a limited edition.

title: Another lap around the sun
text: Congratulations! You have successfully completed another lap around the sun without reading the instructions.

text: Another birthday? Your commitment to this annual tradition is impressive.

text: Happy birthday! Age is just a number. A very persistent number.

title: Future family historian
text: Congratulations! You are one year closer to becoming the family historian.

title: Invisible chores wish
text: Happy birthday! May your presents be expensive and your chores invisible.

title: New level unlocked
text: You have unlocked a new level! Happy birthday, champion!

title: Warranty check: fabulous
text: Happy birthday! We checked your warranty. Still fabulous.

title: The VIP has entered the chat
text: Attention, everyone! The birthday VIP has entered the chat.

title: Your inner child wants dessert
text: Happy birthday! Your inner child has requested more dessert.

title: Another year wiser?
text: Another year wiser? Let us not put pressure on the process.

title: Flattering selfies, big cake
text: Happy birthday! May your selfies be flattering and your cake enormous.

title: Main character birthday
text: Today you are the main character. Happy birthday!

title: Your phone insists

title: Attention requested

title: The digital doorbell

text: Whoosh! I have made a dramatic exit.

title: Ta-da, unnecessary suspense
text: Ta-da! The suspense was unnecessary.

text: Warning! Awkward silence approaching.

title: Womp womp
text: Womp womp. The trophy goes to nobody.

title: Kaboom, it escalated
text: Kaboom! That escalated emotionally.

title: Squeak, the mouse objects
text: Squeak! The mouse has filed an objection.

text: Drumroll, please! Oh. Never mind.

title: Maximum silliness unlocked
text: Ta-da! You have unlocked maximum silliness.
